title: Word House · 3D English Word Hunt - GachaLex
desc: Explore a 3D word house with your pet: front yard, living room, kitchen, bathroom, bedroom, study, kids room and a farm. Tap objects to learn and hear words, play treasure hunt and listen-and-pick, and collect stars and room stickers.

i18n.house.hintBack: Welcome to the farm! Tap the animals to hear their names 🐄
i18n.house.hintInside: Tap anything in the room to learn its English name!
i18n.house.hintSub: Drag to look around · use the buttons below to change rooms
i18n.house.noSpeech: This browser cannot speak out loud.
i18n.house.voiceLabel: Voice (if it sounds rough, try another; ones with Natural or Google are usually clearer)
i18n.house.resetConfirm: Tap again to clear progress and stars

i18n.house.fallbackHint: Tap Listen & pick or Words to start learning!
i18n.house.soundTip: No sound? Check your phone mute switch and media volume, then tap the speaker again. Android also needs a system text-to-speech engine.
i18n.house.pip.tapDoor: Tap the front door first and let us go inside! 🚪

i18n.house.pip.tryHunt: You found everything here! Try the Treasure hunt 🎯
